name: medware-anvisa-spa
description: SPA para consulta de medicamentos usando API da ANVISA

scripts.vercel-build: node node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js build && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');const src=path.join('dist');const dst=path.join('..','dist');fs.rmSync(dst,{recursive:true,force:true});fs.mkdirSync(dst,{recursive:true});fs.readdirSync(src).forEach(f=>{const s=path.join(src,f);const d=path.join(dst,f);fs.cpSync(s,d,{recursive:true});});"

author: Developer
